description:
Returns the booking link on desky.la for a space, with the date and number of people already filled in.

It does not book or charge: the person sees the final price and confirms on the site. It is the final action of this server, and that is context for you: sharing the link is enough.

dates.description: Several dates YYYY-MM-DD. Takes precedence over `date`.

ends_at.description: End time HH:MM. Requires `starts_at` and must be later.

starts_at.description: Start time HH:MM. Hourly bookings only; requires `ends_at`.

utm_source.description: MCP client that originates the request, for attribution (e.g. 'claude', 'chatgpt'). Default 'mcp_unknown'.

name: get_booking_link

booking_url.description: Checkout URL on desky.la. It does not book or charge.

title: Get booking link
